fnol_text: My name is Rafael Wojcik and I live at 492 Marigold Drive, Riverton, WY 82525. You can reach me on (555) 628-9370 or rafael.wojcik@example.com. There was a flood warning for our area from the day before, but I left the car parked on the street by the river. On 26 June 2024 the water rose and the car was flooded up to the seats. Policy MT-2023-00015. I'd like to claim for the damage to my car.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Dr Wojcik on (555) 628-9370 to acknowledge the claim. Rafael confirmed the loss date as 26 June 2024.
Vehicle inspected at the repairer. Witness Naomi Whitlock gave a statement by phone.
Rafael sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
